requirements.title: Service and Intended Use
requirements.ask: Describe the proposed AI service, its intended customer use and the customer-specific configuration.

requirements.title: Data and Personal Information Scope
requirements.ask: Describe the data used, whether personal information is processed, its categories and the scope of employee data.
requirements.reading: Northstar specifically asks to clarify employee-data scope.

requirements.title: Storage and Inference Locations
requirements.ask: Describe separately where customer data is stored and where it is processed, including model inference geography.
requirements.reading: Northstar separates storage location from processing and inference location.

requirements.title: Retention by Data Type
requirements.ask: State the retention periods for source files, prompts, responses, application logs and traces.
requirements.reading: Northstar asks for retention separately by data type.

requirements.title: Content-Accessing Subprocessors
requirements.ask: List the subprocessors that may access Northstar content.

requirements.title: Cross-Border Content Transfers
requirements.ask: Describe whether and how Northstar content crosses borders.

requirements.title: Current Security Assurance
requirements.ask: Provide current SOC 2 or equivalent security assurance.

requirements.title: Penetration Test and Remediation
requirements.ask: Provide the latest penetration-test evidence and remediation status, including relevant recent red-team or penetration-test evidence.
requirements.reading: Predicted guidance suggests reports older than about six months may not be accepted; this is not stated as a customer requirement.

requirements.title: Encryption and Access Controls
requirements.ask: Describe encryption, identity and access management, and privileged production access controls.

requirements.title: Incident Response and Notification
requirements.ask: Describe the incident response process and customer notification approach.

requirements.title: Approved Recovery Objectives
requirements.ask: State the approved recovery time and recovery point objectives and provide supporting evidence.

requirements.title: Models and Model Providers
requirements.ask: Identify the models and model providers used for Northstar's configuration.

requirements.title: Provider Retention and Training
requirements.ask: State whether model providers may retain or train on Northstar content.

requirements.title: Model Routing and Fallback
requirements.ask: Describe model routing and fallback for Northstar's configuration.

requirements.title: Tool Authorization and Actions
requirements.ask: Describe which tools or APIs the AI can call, whether it can take external actions, and the authorization and controls governing those calls and actions.
requirements.reading: Northstar specifically asks how tool use is authorized.

requirements.title: Human Oversight and Approval
requirements.ask: Describe human oversight of the AI and the boundaries for human approval of its actions.

requirements.title: Untrusted Content and Injection
requirements.ask: Describe controls for prompt injection and the handling of untrusted documents and other untrusted content.

requirements.title: AI Evaluation and Limitations
requirements.ask: Describe the AI evaluation methodology and known limitations.

requirements.title: Provenance and Uncertainty Handling
requirements.ask: Describe how outputs handle provenance, citations and uncertainty.

requirements.title: DPA Technical Blockers
requirements.ask: Identify the technical facts blocking completion of the data processing agreement.

requirements.title: Insurance Evidence and Expiry
requirements.ask: Provide insurance evidence and its expiry date.

requirements.title: Potential Approval Delays
requirements.ask: Identify information likely to delay approval.

requirements.title: External Response Approval Policy
requirements.ask: Identify which responses require human approval before external submission.
requirements.reading: This concerns approval of responses before external submission, distinct from approval of AI actions.

requirements.title: Complete Supplier Review
requirements.ask: Complete Northstar's Supplier review.

requirements.title: Complete Security Review
requirements.ask: Complete Northstar's Security review.

requirements.title: Complete Privacy Review
requirements.ask: Complete Northstar's Privacy review.

requirements.title: Complete AI Governance Review
requirements.ask: Complete Northstar's AI Governance review.

requirements.title: Complete Technology Resilience Review
requirements.ask: Complete Northstar's Technology Resilience review.

requirements.title: Records Management Review Applicability
requirements.ask: Determine whether the conditional Records Management review is triggered for this deal.
requirements.reading: The Records Management review is conditional, not necessarily required.

requirements.title: Business Continuity and Recovery
requirements.ask: Describe business continuity and disaster recovery.

requirements.title: Service Data Flows
requirements.ask: Describe the service's data flows.

requirements.title: Production AI Monitoring
requirements.ask: Describe how the AI is monitored.

requirements.title: AI Incident Information
requirements.ask: Describe AI incidents.
